projectCategory: DSA Module 4.2: KMP & Rabin-Karp String Pattern Matching Algorithms
subject: Data Structures & Algorithms in C

projects.title: Naive String Pattern Matching Engine
projects.description: The Naive String Matching algorithm slides a pattern P of length M over a text T of length N, checking character-by-character alignment at every position `0 <= i <= N - M`. If a mismatch occurs, it resets the pattern index back to 0 and advances text position by 1, taking `O(N * M)` worst-case time complexity. In this project, you will build a Naive String Pattern Matcher in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Brute-Force Pattern Matching, Character Comparison Loops & O(N*M) Worst-Case Behavior
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Naive Pattern Search ---
Matches at indices: 0 9 12
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Outer Loop**: Iterate text index `i` from `0` to `N - M`.
2. **Inner Loop**: Compare `text[i + j]` with `pat[j]`. If `j == M`, pattern match found at index `i`.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `naive_search()`: Performs brute-force string pattern matching.

projects.title: KMP Longest Prefix Suffix (LPS / Pi Array) Computation
projects.description: The core component of the Knuth-Morris-Pratt (KMP) algorithm is the Longest Prefix Suffix (LPS) table `lps[i]`, which stores the length of the longest proper prefix of `pat[0..i]` that is also a suffix of `pat[0..i]`. Constructing the LPS table in O(M) time allows KMP to skip redundant character re-comparisons during search. In this project, you will build an LPS Table Generator in C.
projects.learningOutcome: LPS Pre-computation, Proper Prefix & Suffix Overlaps & Linear O(M) Table Building
projects.exampleOutput:
--- KMP LPS Array Computation ---
Pattern: AAACAAAA
LPS Array: [ 0 1 2 0 1 2 3 3 ]
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **LPS Pointer**: Maintain `len` (length of previous longest prefix suffix).
2. **Shift Logic**: If `pat[i] == pat[len]`, set `lps[i] = ++len`; else if `len != 0`, set `len = lps[len-1]` without advancing `i`.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `compute_lps()`: Generates the KMP LPS array in O(M) time.

projects.title: Complete Knuth-Morris-Pratt (KMP) Pattern Matcher in O(N + M)
projects.description: The Knuth-Morris-Pratt (KMP) algorithm achieves linear `O(N + M)` pattern matching without ever backtracking the text pointer `i`! When a character mismatch occurs after matching `j` characters, KMP shifts the pattern using `j = lps[j - 1]`. In this project, you will build a complete KMP Pattern Matcher in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Knuth-Morris-Pratt Algorithm, Non-Backtracking Text Pointer & Linear O(N+M) Time Guarantee
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Complete KMP Pattern Matcher ---
Matches at indices: 10
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Text Scan**: Advance text index `i` continuously.
2. **LPS Shift**: On mismatch, update `j = lps[j-1]` to reuse previously matched character prefixes.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `kmp_search()`: Executes full KMP linear pattern matching algorithm.

projects.title: Rabin-Karp Rolling Hash Pattern Matcher
projects.description: The Rabin-Karp algorithm converts pattern and text windows into numerical integer hashes using Polynomial Rolling Hashing `hash = (D * hash + char) % Q`. Sliding the window recalculates the hash in O(1) time by subtracting the leading character and adding the trailing character. In this project, you will build a Rabin-Karp Matcher in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Rabin-Karp Rolling Hash, Modulo Arithmetic & O(1) Window Hash Updates
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Rabin-Karp Rolling Hash Matcher ---
Matches at indices: 0 10
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Rolling Hash Formula**: `t_hash = (D * (t_hash - text[i]*h) + text[i+m]) % Q`.
2. **Character Verification**: If window hash matches pattern hash, verify characters to avoid false positives.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `rabin_karp_search()`: Performs rolling hash pattern search.

projects.title: Multi-Pattern Hash Collision Handling in Rabin-Karp
projects.description: Due to finite hash modulo `Q`, distinct strings can produce identical hash values (Spurious Hits). Rabin-Karp handles hash collisions by performing explicit character-by-character verification whenever window hash equals pattern hash. In this project, you will build a Collision-Resistant Rabin-Karp Engine in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Spurious Hit Detection, Explicit Verification Passes & False Positive Mitigation
projects.exampleText: Handle spurious hash collision in Rabin-Karp
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Rabin-Karp Spurious Hit Hash Collision Handler ---
Spurious Hash Hit detected at index 3 (Hash=42). Character validation rejected false positive.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Hash Equality**: Detect `pattern_hash == window_hash`.
2. **Verification Loop**: Run character-by-character check; reject match if characters differ.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `hash_collision_handling_demo()`: Demonstrates Rabin-Karp spurious hit verification.

projects.title: Repeated Substring Pattern Check using KMP LPS Array
projects.description: Given a string S, check if it can be constructed by taking a substring of it and appending multiple copies of the substring together. Compute the LPS array for S: if `lps[N-1] > 0` and `N % (N - lps[N-1]) == 0`, S is a repeated pattern! In this project, you will build a Repeated Substring Checker in C in O(N) time.
projects.learningOutcome: KMP LPS Structural Invariants, Periodicity Proofs & Substring Repeat Detection
projects.exampleText: Check if 'abcabcabc' is a repeated pattern
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Repeated Substring Pattern via KMP LPS ---
'abcabcabc' → REPEATED Pattern
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **LPS End**: Extract `len = lps[N-1]`.
2. **Periodicity Condition**: `len > 0 && N % (N - len) == 0` confirms repeated substring periodicity.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `repeated_substring_pattern()`: Detects repeated substring periodicity via LPS array.

projects.title: Rotate String Verification using KMP Substring Match
projects.description: Given two strings S and Goal, check if Goal can be obtained by rotating S. Concatenate `S + S`: Goal is a valid rotation of S if and only if Goal is a substring of `S + S` AND `len(S) == len(Goal)`. Search Goal inside `S + S` using KMP in O(N) time! In this project, you will build a Rotate String Matcher in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Doubled String Concatenation (`S + S`), Substring Rotation Proofs & KMP Integration
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Rotate String Verification ---
'cdeab' is rotation of 'abcde': YES
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Double String**: Concatenate `temp = S + S`.
2. **KMP Search**: Search Goal inside `temp` using KMP in O(N) time.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `rotate_string()`: Verifies string rotation via doubled string KMP search.

projects.title: Shortest Palindrome Addition (LPS Table Inversion)
projects.description: You are given a string S. You can convert it to a Palindrome by adding characters in front of it. Find the shortest palindrome you can create. Form string `temp = S + '#' + Reverse(S)`. The last value of `lps[len-1]` gives the length of the longest palindromic prefix of S! In this project, you will build a Shortest Palindrome Engine in C in O(N) time.
projects.learningOutcome: Palindromic Prefix Identification, Reversed String Inversion & LPS Table Exploitation
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Shortest Palindrome Addition (LPS Inversion) ---
Shortest Palindrome of 'aacecaaa' → 'aaacecaaa'
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Combined String**: Form `temp = S + '#' + Rev(S)`.
2. **LPS Prefix**: `lps[len-1]` gives length of longest palindrome starting at index 0.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `shortest_palindrome_demo()`: Solves shortest palindrome addition using LPS table.

projects.title: Count Pattern Occurrences in Text with Overlapping Patterns
projects.description: Count how many times pattern P occurs in text T, INCLUDING overlapping occurrences (e.g. pattern `'AA'` in text `'AAAAA'` appears 4 times). Standard KMP resets `j = lps[j-1]` after finding a match, enabling overlapping match detection in O(N) time. In this project, you will build an Overlapping Pattern Counter in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Overlapping Pattern Matches, Match Reset Logic & Substring Frequency Counting
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Overlapping Pattern Occurrences Count ---
Pattern 'AA' in 'AAAAA' (Overlapping) Count = 4
projects.logicExplanation: 1. **Match Reset**: Upon match `j == M`, increment count and reset `j = lps[j-1]` to allow overlapping matches.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `count_pattern_occurrences()`: Counts overlapping pattern matches.

projects.title: Z-Algorithm Fundamental Z-Array Construction
projects.description: The Z-Algorithm constructs a Z-Array where `Z[i]` is the length of the longest substring starting from `s[i]` that is also a prefix of `s`. Using a sliding Z-box `[L, R]`, the Z-array is constructed in linear O(N) time! In this project, you will build a Z-Array Construction Engine in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Z-Algorithm Fundamentals, Sliding Z-Box `[L, R]` & Linear O(N) Prefix Matching
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Z-Algorithm Z-Array Construction ---
Z-Array values: [ 0 1 0 0 4 1 0 0 0 8 1 0 0 4 1 0 0 1 0 ]
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Z-Box Maintenance**: Track interval `[L, R]` of latest matched prefix.
2. **Box Reuse**: Use `Z[k]` when inside `[L, R]` to compute `Z[i]` in O(1) steps.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `construct_z_array()`: Constructs Z-array in linear O(N) time.

projects.title: Z-Algorithm Pattern Matching Engine
projects.description: Perform pattern matching using Z-Algorithm. Form combined string `P + '#' + T`. Compute Z-array for combined string: any index `i` where `Z[i] == len(P)` indicates a pattern match at text index `i - len(P) - 1` in linear O(N + M) time! In this project, you will build a Z-Algorithm Pattern Matcher in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Z-Algorithm Pattern Matching, Combined Delimited Strings & Linear O(N+M) Search
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Z-Algorithm Pattern Matcher ---
Pattern 'abc' found in text at indices: [ 0, 7 ]
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Delimited String**: `temp = P + '#' + T`.
2. **Z-Match Check**: If `Z[i] == len(P)`, pattern match found at `i - len(P) - 1`.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `z_pattern_match_demo()`: Solves pattern matching using Z-algorithm.

projects.title: Boyer-Moore Bad Character Rule Pattern Matcher
projects.description: The Boyer-Moore algorithm scans pattern characters from RIGHT TO LEFT (`j = M - 1` down to 0). When a mismatch occurs at `text[s + j]`, the Bad Character Rule shifts the pattern right by `max(1, j - BadChar[text[s + j]])`, skipping up to M comparisons per step! In this project, you will build a Boyer-Moore Bad Character Matcher in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Boyer-Moore Algorithm, Bad Character Heuristic Table & Sub-Linear Average Search
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Boyer-Moore Bad Character Matcher ---
Matches at indices: 4 10
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Right-to-Left Compare**: Compare pattern from `j = M - 1` down to 0.
2. **Bad Char Shift**: Shift pattern alignment by `j - BadChar[text[s+j]]`.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `boyer_moore_search()` & `bad_char_heuristic()`: Implements Boyer-Moore Bad Character rule.

projects.title: Boyer-Moore Good Suffix Rule Optimization
projects.description: Combine the Bad Character Rule with the Good Suffix Rule in Boyer-Moore. When a mismatch occurs, if a suffix of pattern has matched, shift pattern to align with the next occurrence of that suffix in the pattern. Take `shift = max(BadCharShift, GoodSuffixShift)`. In this project, you will build a Good Suffix Optimizer in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Good Suffix Heuristic, Dual Heuristic Maximization & Sub-Linear Performance
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Boyer-Moore Good Suffix Rule Optimization ---
Applied Good Suffix shift heuristic skipping 5 redundant character comparisons.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Good Suffix Shift**: Precompute shift distance for matching pattern suffixes.
2. **Max Shift**: Use `max(bad_char_shift, good_suffix_shift)`.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `good_suffix_demo()`: Demonstrates Boyer-Moore Good Suffix rule optimization.

projects.title: Substring Search in Matrix Rows & Columns using KMP
projects.description: Given an `R x C` matrix of characters, find all occurrences of a 1D pattern string across all rows and columns. Execute KMP search on each matrix row and column string. In this project, you will build a 2D Matrix KMP Search Engine in C.
projects.learningOutcome: 2D Grid Character Scanning, KMP Row/Col Iteration & Substring Locating
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Substring Search in Matrix Rows & Columns via KMP ---
Pattern 'DATA' found at Row 2, Column 0.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Row Scan**: Run KMP on row strings `0..R-1`.
2. **Col Scan**: Extract column strings `0..C-1` and run KMP search.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `matrix_kmp_demo()`: Performs KMP pattern matching on 2D matrix rows and columns.

projects.title: Rabin-Karp 2D Matrix Pattern Search
projects.description: Find a 2D pattern matrix of size `r x c` inside a larger text matrix of size `R x C`. Compute 2D rolling hashes for submatrices: first compute 1D row hashes, then compute 1D column hashes of the row hashes. In this project, you will build a 2D Rabin-Karp Submatrix Search Engine in C.
projects.learningOutcome: 2D Rolling Hash Math, Submatrix Hashes & 2D Pattern Locating in Linear O(R*C) Time
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Rabin-Karp 2D Matrix Pattern Search ---
2D Submatrix Pattern (2x2) matched at Matrix Top-Left Index (1, 1).
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **2D Hash Matrix**: Compute 1D row hashes, then compute column hashes of row hashes.
2. **Submatrix Match**: Compare 2D submatrix hash with 2D pattern hash.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `rabin_karp_2d_demo()`: Solves 2D submatrix pattern search via 2D Rabin-Karp rolling hashes.

projects.title: Find All Anagrams using Rabin-Karp Rolling Character Hashes
projects.description: Find all start indices of anagrams of pattern P in string S. Instead of array comparisons, assign a unique polynomial hash to character counts and slide a Rabin-Karp rolling hash window across S in O(N) time. In this project, you will build an Anagram Rolling Hash Engine in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Anagram Rolling Hash, Character Polynomial Signatures & O(N) Sliding Search
projects.exampleText: Find anagram start indices using Rabin-Karp
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Find All Anagrams via Rabin-Karp Rolling Character Hashes ---
Anagram rolling hash matched at indices: [ 0, 6 ]
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Character Signature**: Assign prime powers to characters (`hash = sum(char^3 % Q)`).
2. **Rolling Hash Window**: Update signature in O(1) as window slides across text.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `anagram_rolling_hash_demo()`: Finds anagram start indices using Rabin-Karp rolling character hashes.

projects.title: Longest Happy Prefix (Equal Prefix & Suffix using LPS)
projects.description: A Happy Prefix is a non-empty prefix which is also a suffix (excluding the string itself). Find the longest happy prefix of S. Compute KMP LPS array for S: `lps[N-1]` gives length of longest happy prefix! Extract `S[0 .. lps[N-1]-1]`. In this project, you will build a Longest Happy Prefix Finder in C in O(N) time.
projects.learningOutcome: Longest Happy Prefix, LPS Array Applications & String Prefix Extraction
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Longest Happy Prefix (Equal Prefix & Suffix via LPS) ---
Longest Happy Prefix for 'level' → 'l'
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **LPS Computation**: Build LPS array for string S.
2. **Prefix Slice**: Extract prefix substring of length `lps[N-1]`.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `happy_prefix_demo()`: Finds longest happy prefix using KMP LPS array.

projects.title: Minimum Additions to Make Pattern Periodic
projects.description: Given a pattern P, find minimum characters to add to the end of P so that P becomes a periodic repeating string. Use KMP LPS table to determine pattern period length `N - lps[N-1]`. In this project, you will build a Periodic Pattern Optimizer in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Pattern Periodicity, LPS Period Math (`N - lps[N-1]`) & Minimum Character Additions
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Minimum Additions to Make Pattern Periodic ---
Minimum character additions to achieve periodic length: 2
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Period Calculation**: `period = N - lps[N-1]`.
2. **Remaining Completion**: `additions = period - (N % period)`.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `periodic_pattern_demo()`: Computes minimum additions to achieve pattern periodicity.

projects.title: Double Hash Rabin-Karp Matcher (Eliminating False Positives)
projects.description: Single rolling hashes can produce collision false positives in giant text corpora. Double Hash Rabin-Karp uses TWO large coprime prime moduli (e.g. `Q1 = 10^9 + 7`, `Q2 = 10^9 + 9`). Matching BOTH hashes reduces false positive probability to near ZERO (`< 10^-18`) without requiring character checks! In this project, you will build a Double Hash Rabin-Karp Engine in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Double Polynomial Hashing, Coprime Moduli `Q1, Q2` & Zero-Verification Match Guarantees
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Double Hash Rabin-Karp Matcher ---
Dual Moduli (Q1=10^9+7, Q2=10^9+9) verified match with 0% false positive probability.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Dual Hashes**: Compute `hash1` and `hash2` simultaneously.
2. **Zero False Positives**: Match confirmed if both `hash1` and `hash2` match.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `double_hash_rabin_karp_demo()`: Performs double hash Rabin-Karp pattern matching.

projects.title: Pattern Matching in DNA Genome Sequences (AGCT Alphabet KMP)
projects.description: Genomic sequence alignment searches for specific DNA motifs (`'A', 'C', 'G', 'T'`) across gigabyte genome text. Optimize KMP algorithm for small 4-character DNA alphabet to speed up medical sequence alignment. In this project, you will build a DNA Genome KMP Matcher in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Bioinformatics Sequence Alignment, 4-Letter DNA Alphabet Optimization & KMP Genomic Search
projects.exampleOutput:
--- DNA Genome Sequence KMP Pattern Matcher ---
DNA Motif 'AGCT' found in Genome Sequence at index 1024.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **4-Letter Alphabet**: Optimize LPS table for AGCT alphabet.
2. **Genome Pass**: Run KMP on long DNA genome strings.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `dna_genome_kmp_demo()`: Performs KMP pattern matching on DNA genome sequences.

projects.title: Wildcard Pattern Matching with Single Unknown Symbols via KMP
projects.description: Search pattern containing wildcard unknown symbols `?` (e.g. `'a?c'`) in text using KMP. Modify KMP character comparison: `?` matches ANY text character during LPS computation and text scanning. In this project, you will build a Wildcard KMP Matcher in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Wildcard Character Comparison, Modified KMP LPS Rules & Single-Symbol Wildcard Matching
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Wildcard KMP Pattern Matcher ---
Matched wildcard pattern 'a?c' at index 4.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Wildcard Compare**: `pat[j] == '?' || pat[j] == text[i]` counts as match.
2. **LPS Modification**: Account for `?` wildcard during LPS array generation.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `wildcard_kmp_demo()`: Performs KMP pattern matching with wildcard `?` characters.

projects.title: Shifted Alphabet Pattern Matching (Cyclic Shift Matching)
projects.description: Find if pattern P matches text T under any constant Caesar Cipher shift (e.g. `'abc'` shifted by +1 becomes `'bcd'`). Compute difference array of adjacent character ASCII values `pat_diff[i] = pat[i+1] - pat[i]`. Run KMP on difference arrays in O(N) time! In this project, you will build Shifted Alphabet KMP Matcher in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Adjacent Difference Transformation, Caesar Shift Invariants & Structural KMP Matching
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Shifted Alphabet Pattern Matching ---
Pattern 'bcd' matched text 'abc' with Caesar Shift +1 at index 0.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Difference Array**: Transform text and pattern into adjacent character difference arrays.
2. **KMP Difference Match**: Run KMP on difference arrays to detect cyclic shift matches.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `cyclic_shift_kmp_demo()`: Performs shifted alphabet pattern matching using KMP.

projects.title: Aho-Corasick Multi-Pattern Failure Link Automaton
projects.description: Combine Trie with KMP failure links to search for 1,000 patterns in text in a single pass O(N) time. Build BFS failure links `fail[node]` pointing to longest proper suffix node. In this project, you will build Aho-Corasick Multi-Pattern Automaton in C.
projects.learningOutcome: Aho-Corasick Failure Links, Multi-Pattern State Machines & O(N) Multi-Keyword Search
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Aho-Corasick Multi-Pattern Failure Link Automaton ---
Failure links constructed. Processed 1,000 patterns in single text pass.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **BFS Failure Links**: Compute failure links layer-by-layer using BFS queue.
2. **State Automaton**: Advance along failure links on character mismatches.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `aho_corasick_kmp_demo()`: Implements Aho-Corasick multi-pattern failure link automaton.

projects.title: Parallel GPU-Accelerated Rabin-Karp Rolling Hash Engine
projects.description: Accelerate large-scale text searching by running Rabin-Karp rolling hash calculations across thousands of GPU threads concurrently. Split text into overlapping blocks and compute 10,000 window hashes per clock cycle. In this project, you will build a GPU Rabin-Karp Simulator in C.
projects.learningOutcome: GPU Thread Grid Partitioning, Massively Parallel Rolling Hashing & High-Throughput Search
projects.exampleText: GPU parallel rolling hash across 10,000 windows
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Parallel GPU-Accelerated Rabin-Karp Rolling Hash Engine ---
Computed 10,000 rolling hash windows in parallel across CUDA thread blocks.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Overlapping Text Blocks**: Partition text across GPU thread blocks.
2. **Parallel Hash Compute**: Compute window hashes concurrently in GPU shared memory.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `gpu_rabin_karp_demo()`: Simulates GPU-accelerated Rabin-Karp rolling hash engine.

projects.title: Hardware SIMD Vectorized KMP Pattern Scan Kernel
projects.description: High-speed network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) scan multi-gigabyte packet streams for malicious signatures using SIMD (Single Instruction Multiple Data) AVX-512 vector registers, scanning 64 text characters per instruction pass. In this project, you will build SIMD Vectorized KMP Kernel in C.
projects.learningOutcome: SIMD AVX-512 Vector Registers, Hardware-Accelerated Pattern Scanning & NIDS Network Search
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Hardware SIMD Vectorized KMP Pattern Scan Kernel ---
Scanned 1GB string buffer for pattern using 512-bit AVX-512 vector registers.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **512-bit Vector Load**: Load 64 characters into AVX-512 register.
2. **Vector Compare**: Execute 64 character comparisons simultaneously in 1 CPU cycle.
projects.codeExplanation: 1. `simd_kmp_demo()`: Simulates SIMD vectorized KMP pattern scanning kernel.
